Send 5 spearmen from Sevilha to Cordoba. Build archers in Cordoba and spearmen in Madrid, Vigo, Toledo, Sevilha, Burgos, Castellon, Teruel. B.plano: Reinforced Murcia and Zaragoza; built spearmen everywhere. Next turn, build archers in Barcelona and Zaragoza to prepare attack on Castellon. Keep defenses in Barcelona and Girona strong; avoid risky attacks until we have archer advantage.

A.depoimento: I ordered the strike on Valencia, sending nearly all of Castellon's fighting troops to overwhelm the weak enemy garrison. Reinforcements from Teruel and Madrid are marching to Castellon to prepare for the next push on Tarragona. The enemy may try to exploit our reduced defenses, but I trust we can hold the line and expand our territory.
A.plano: Attack Valencia with minimal force from Castellon to capture it, leaving 4 spearman. Send archers and knights from Teruel to Castellon to build an archer-heavy army for the Tarragona assault next turn. Send some spearman from Madrid to Castellon for reinforcement. Watch for enemy attacks on Castellon or Madrid; if Castellon falls, retake it. Next turn, combine all forces in Castellon and attack Tarragona with archer main to exploit the counter bonus.

B.depoimento: Ordered a knight to be built in each of our villages to boost future attack power.\nSent spearmen and archers from Murcia to strengthen Valencia's defenses.\nMaintained all other holdings, focusing on defense and buildup.

A.depoimento: We spent this turn consolidating our forces and preparing the final blow for Tarragona. Our archers were built in every capable village, and we established a smooth reinforcement pipeline from Toledo through Madrid and Teruel to Castellon. By waiting for these troops to arrive, we ensure that our attack on Tarragona next turn is unstoppable, while our borders remain securely defended.
A.plano: This turn we focused on building archers across all our villages to exploit the enemy's spearman-heavy composition. We coordinated a reinforcement chain: Toledo sends 8 spearman to Madrid, Madrid sends 10 spearman to Teruel, and Teruel sends 5 archers to Castellon. We do not attack Tarragona yet; we wait for these reinforcements to arrive next turn so we can launch an overwhelming archer assault on Tarragona while keeping a strong garrison in Castellon. Next turn, we will attack Tarragona with the combined forces.

A.depoimento: This turn, we maximized our economy by building 20 archers and 1 knight across our villages, preparing for the campaigns ahead. We marched a strong force from Burgos to strike at Zaragoza, whose defenses are crumbling. To secure our eastern flank, we sent reinforcements to Castellon and Teruel, anticipating the enemy's assault on our lands. We stand ready to expand our territory and bring our total to 18 villages.
A.plano: This turn we focused on building archers across all our villages to exploit the enemy's spearman-heavy composition. We sent a strong force from Burgos to capture the weakly defended Zaragoza (def 3). We reinforced Castellon from Teruel and Madrid to prepare for the enemy's attack on Castellon. Next turn, we will check the outcome of the Castellon defense, consolidate our hold on Zaragoza, and plan the next attack on Tarragona or Valencia.

B.depoimento: This turn I ordered two spearmen built in each of my villages and sent thirty spearmen from Girona, Valencia, Murcia, Barcelona, Tarragona, and Pamplona to strengthen Zaragoza's garrison against approaching enemy forces.
B.plano: Reinforce Zaragoza with spearmen to withstand incoming enemy armies; build spearmen in all villages to grow manpower; keep border defenses adequate; avoid risky assaults on Burgos, Castellon, Madrid this turn.

A.depoimento: Our armies struck hard and fast: Castellon's archers and knights thundered toward Tarragona, while Cordoba's spearmans marched on Murcia. From the interior, reinforcements flowed to shield our borders—Sevilha, Badajoz, Salamanca, Toledo, and Vigo all sent their warriors to fortify Castellon, Cordoba, Madrid, and Burgos. We stand on the threshold of victory, needing only to hold 18 villages for two turns. The battle for Spain rages on.
A.plano: This turn we built archers in all villages and launched attacks on Tarragona and Murcia to reach 18 villages. We reinforced Castellon from Teruel, and Cordoba from Sevilha and Badajoz. We also reinforced Madrid and Burgos to secure our borders. We did not send additional troops to Zaragoza due to heavy enemy reinforcements. Next turn, we will assess the battle results, consolidate our new territories, and prepare for enemy counterattacks.

B.depoimento: This turn I sent spearmen from Barcelona to Tarragona and from Girona to Huesca, then from Huesca to Zaragoza, while Valencia sent spearmen to Murcia. I also ordered two spearmen to be built in each village. No attacks were launched.
B.plano: Reinforce Tarragona and Zaragoza with spearmen to stop incoming enemy armies; build spearmen in every village to increase manpower; hold current positions and avoid risky assaults on Cordoba, Madrid, Burgos, or Castellon this turn.

A.depoimento: Ordered the assault on Huesca to expand our territory and pressure the enemy capital's approaches. Simultaneously, we are reinforcing our newly gained lands (Zaragoza, Tarragona) and strengthening Burgos against the massive Pamplona garrison. Our archers and spearmen are flowing to the front lines to secure the victory and maintain our hold on 18 villages.
A.plano: Attacking Huesca with all Zaragoza troops to conquer a key border village. Reinforcing Zaragoza from Madrid and Teruel, and Burgos from Madrid to secure our borders. Building spearman and archer in border villages to increase defense. Next turn, assess the Huesca battle and prepare to push towards Girona or defend against enemy counterattacks on Tarragona and Castellon.

B.depoimento: I sent Girona's and Valencia's troops to bolster Huesca and Murcia, ordered spearmen production everywhere, and kept a defensive posture.
B.plano: Reinforce Huesca and Murcia with all available troops from Girona and Valencia. Build two spearmen in each village to replace losses. Hold current line and avoid offensive moves on Cordoba, Madrid, Burgos, or Castellon this turn.

A.depoimento: This turn, we focused on strengthening our defenses and expanding our territory. We sent troops from Castellon to conquer the weakly defended Valencia, while reinforcing Teruel and Cordoba against potential attacks from Murcia. We also bolstered our border villages of Tarragona and Burgos. Our builders worked tirelessly across the realm to produce spearman and archer to fill our ranks. We await the results of our attacks and hope to secure Valencia to bring us closer to victory.
A.plano: Focus on securing borders and conquering Valencia. Reinforced Teruel from Castellon and Madrid, and Cordoba from Sevilha to defend against Murcia. Sent troops from Castellon to conquer Valencia. Reinforced Tarragona from Zaragoza and Burgos from Vigo. Next turn, check the results of the Valencia attack and Teruel defense, and assess if we can push towards Barcelona or Huesca.

B.depoimento: Built two spearmen in each of our six villages. Sent ten spearmen, three archers, and two knights from Murcia to Valencia to arrive next turn. Held the line and prepared for defense.
B.plano: Reinforce Valencia next turn with troops from Murcia. Keep Murcia's garrison strong enough to repel enemy attack. Build spearmen in all villages to increase reserves. Avoid offensive actions this turn.
